forge-001.name: Bellows Apprentice
forge-001.flavor: The first job is to keep the fire alive.

forge-002.name: Wandering Spark
forge-002.flavor: No one knows which forge it escaped from.

forge-003.name: Copper Hound
forge-003.flavor: It smells the salt and runs toward the light.

forge-004.name: Anvil Guard
forge-004.flavor: He took more blows than the anvil itself.

forge-005.name: Ember Thrower
forge-005.flavor: A well-thrown ember is worth a sword.

forge-007.name: Slag Brute
forge-007.flavor: Made from scraps, and angry about it.

forge-008.name: Flare Signaller
forge-008.flavor: Her first flare is always a greeting.

forge-009.name: Tidebreaker Smith
forge-009.flavor: He strikes the iron and the sea steps back.

forge-010.name: Rivet Archer
forge-010.flavor: Every rivet has a name carved on it.

forge-011.name: Foundry Champion
forge-011.flavor: The foundry sings when he fights.

forge-014.name: Mother of Furnaces
forge-014.flavor: Every fire in the archipelago is her child.

forge-016.name: Sparkburst
forge-016.flavor: A beacon sees the light. Then it sees the fire.

forge-018.name: Bellows Gust
forge-018.flavor: The hot wind pushes the sea too.

forge-019.name: Molten Rain
forge-019.flavor: The drops never touch the water.

forge-020.name: Heat Surge
forge-020.flavor: At high tide, steam becomes a weapon.

forge-021.name: Overheat
forge-021.flavor: A strong fire asks for a price.

forge-024.name: Blazing Foundry
forge-024.flavor: Here the air itself is a weapon.

forge-025.name: Ember Tithe
forge-025.flavor: The forge lends. The forge takes back.

sprout-002.name: Kelp Weaver
sprout-002.flavor: Every night she adds a thread.

sprout-003.name: Reef Sentinel
sprout-003.flavor: It does not move. It does not need to.

sprout-004.name: Tidepool Tender
sprout-004.flavor: She brings clear water to tired beacons.

sprout-010.name: Old Root Elder
sprout-010.flavor: His roots touch the bottom of the sea.

sprout-011.name: Great Kelp Mother
sprout-011.flavor: The drowned forest breathes with her.

sprout-013.name: Brine Shepherd
sprout-013.flavor: She guides the tide like a flock.

sprout-015.name: Thornshell Crab
sprout-015.flavor: It loses the shell, never the will.

sprout-017.name: Regrowth
sprout-017.flavor: The wound closes before the blow.

sprout-021.name: Pollen Cloud
sprout-021.flavor: The enemy coughs. The enemy hesitates.

sprout-022.name: Coral Crown
sprout-022.flavor: It grows on the head of those who endure.

sprout-023.name: Root Lantern
sprout-023.flavor: A light that feeds on salt.

sprout-024.name: Kelp Forest
sprout-024.flavor: Here every blow gets lost in the green.

sprout-025.name: Spring Tide
sprout-025.flavor: When the moon is right, everything grows.

neutral-spark.name: Spark
neutral-spark.flavor: A small help for the one who starts second.

abyss-001.name: Blind Fisher
abyss-001.flavor: He cannot see the sea, but he feels it pull.

abyss-003.name: Drifting Jelly
abyss-003.flavor: It follows the current that goes down.

abyss-004.name: Trench Crab
abyss-004.flavor: Its shell has never seen the sun.

abyss-005.name: Ink Cuttlefish
abyss-005.flavor: A black cloud, and the blow does not land.

abyss-006.name: Whisper Thief
abyss-006.flavor: She steals thoughts before they become words.

abyss-007.name: Ebb Eel
abyss-007.flavor: It arrives with the water that retreats.

abyss-008.name: Anglerfish
abyss-008.flavor: The light on its head is a false promise.

abyss-009.name: Abyssal Sentinel
abyss-009.flavor: It has looked up for a thousand years.

abyss-010.name: Living Undertow
abyss-010.flavor: The sea takes, and the sea gives back.

abyss-011.name: Eyeless Oracle
abyss-011.flavor: It reads the future in the cold currents.

abyss-013.name: Trench Maw
abyss-013.flavor: When the water falls, the trench is hungry.

abyss-015.name: Ink Cloud
abyss-015.flavor: The dark arrives before the fear.

abyss-016.name: Returning Wave
abyss-016.flavor: Go back to where you came from.

abyss-017.name: Cold Bite
abyss-017.flavor: The bottom of the sea does not forgive.

abyss-018.name: Swallowed
abyss-018.flavor: No light reaches that far down.

abyss-021.name: Call of the Deep
abyss-021.flavor: The deep calls, and the water obeys.

abyss-023.name: Abyss Lantern
abyss-023.flavor: A small light, far from the sun.

abyss-024.name: Echo Shell
abyss-024.flavor: Inside it is the voice of the deep.

abyss-025.name: Trench of Dead Lights
abyss-025.flavor: The lights down there never go out.

abyss-026.name: Shoal Hunter
abyss-026.flavor: It hunts when the sea pulls back.

gear-001.name: Clockmaker Apprentice
gear-001.flavor: He counts the teeth of every wheel.

gear-003.name: Tide Weight
gear-003.flavor: It stops the sea with a brass weight.

gear-004.name: Bronze Warden
gear-004.flavor: It does not sleep, eat or forget.

gear-005.name: Furious Piston
gear-005.flavor: Up and down, harder with every blow.

gear-006.name: Harbor Inventor
gear-006.flavor: Every piece of scrap is an idea.

gear-010.name: Keeper of the Cogs
gear-010.flavor: Every wheel turns because he watches it.

gear-011.name: Copper Giant
gear-011.flavor: It has a boiler for a heart.

gear-012.name: Armored Colossus
gear-012.flavor: The more parts it carries, the worse it is.

gear-013.name: Great Beacon Clock
gear-013.flavor: It strikes the hour for the whole archipelago.

gear-016.name: Plated Armor
gear-016.flavor: Every plate has a serial number.

gear-017.name: Steam Drill
gear-017.flavor: It does not stop at the first obstacle.

gear-018.name: Burning Mirror
gear-018.flavor: It gathers light and gives it back burning.

gear-022.name: Secret Blueprint
gear-022.flavor: The design matters more than the machine.

gear-023.name: Flying Bolt
gear-023.flavor: A lost bolt always finds a target.

gear-024.name: Disassembly
gear-024.flavor: Everything has a screw to remove.

gear-026.name: Automaton Maker
gear-026.flavor: Her first automaton brings her tea.

vesper-001.name: Will-o'-Wisp
vesper-001.flavor: It goes out and lights again.

vesper-002.name: Lantern Bearer
vesper-002.flavor: He carries a light that gives no warmth.

vesper-004.name: Undertow Dancer
vesper-004.flavor: It dances when the sea changes its mind.

vesper-006.name: Cliff Gravedigger
vesper-006.flavor: No one stays buried for long.

vesper-007.name: Dusk Seer
vesper-007.flavor: She sees what the tide takes away.

vesper-009.name: Spectral Knight
vesper-009.flavor: He has fallen in battle three times.

vesper-010.name: Shipwreck Bell-Ringer
vesper-010.flavor: He rings for every lost ship.

vesper-012.name: Crypt Keeper
vesper-012.flavor: When he falls, the crypt opens.

vesper-013.name: Queen of Dead Lanterns
vesper-013.flavor: Every dead lantern is one of her soldiers.

vesper-015.name: Offering to the Mist
vesper-015.flavor: The mist takes; the mist teaches.

vesper-016.name: Call of Souls
vesper-016.flavor: Come back; the night is not over.

vesper-017.name: Spectral Chill
vesper-017.flavor: A shiver that drains all strength.

vesper-019.name: Tide of Memories
vesper-019.flavor: The sea gives back what it remembers.

vesper-022.name: Lantern of Return
vesper-022.flavor: It lights when the sea changes.

vesper-023.name: Sunken Graveyard
vesper-023.flavor: Here the souls do not rest.

vesper-024.name: Twilight Pilgrim
vesper-024.flavor: She walks between the two tides.

vesper-t01.name: Wandering Soul
vesper-t01.flavor: It still looks for the way home.

neutral-001.name: Harbor Deckhand
neutral-001.flavor: He scrubs the deck and dreams of open sea.

neutral-002.name: Sturdy Sailor
neutral-002.flavor: He has seen three storms and laughs about it.

neutral-003.name: Cliff Pirate
neutral-003.flavor: He strikes and runs into the rocks.

neutral-004.name: Fire Warden
neutral-004.flavor: The beacon fire is his oath.

neutral-009.name: Corsair Admiral
neutral-009.flavor: He does not ask; he takes.

neutral-010.name: Ancient Kraken
neutral-010.flavor: The sea was its own before the beacons.

neutral-012.name: Drifting Bottle
neutral-012.flavor: The message always arrives, sooner or later.

neutral-014.name: Beacon Oil
neutral-014.flavor: Every drop is an hour of light.

neutral-019.name: Current Swimmer
neutral-019.flavor: She knows every current by name.

neutral-020.name: Coal Merchant
neutral-020.flavor: He pays in embers and sells in smoke.

forge-026.name: Blaze Rider
forge-026.flavor: He arrives with fire and strikes with fire.
